model: One drawer with list and selected Run detail states.
list: compact type/status/time/Scenario-Version row and useful short ID
focus: Detail Back returns focus to the selected Run row.

emptyState.title: No saved Runs yet
emptyState.description: Run a simulation or optimization to create one.

actionRules: Run again only when a canonical input snapshot is available and dataset guards pass.
Generate Report only for eligible successful Runs with a source Version.
Apply only to applicable retained optimization solutions and existing Version/branch guards.
Delete remains subject to existing reference protections.
persistence: Run record schema, ordering, identity, historical rerun, solution IDs, and report source binding are unchanged.
